Package com.hiface.sdk.flow

Class FaceFlowResult

java.lang.Object
com.hiface.sdk.flow.FaceFlowResult
public final class FaceFlowResult extends java.lang.Object
Result shared by standalone liveness, dynamic 1:1, and combined verification.

First branch on acceptance, then use the final outcome to explain rejection:


 public void onResult(FaceFlowResult result) {
     if (result.isPassed()) {
         accept(result);
     } else {
         reject(result.getOutcome());
     }
 }

Attached scores and images are optional. Null always means that the operation did not produce that item, not a zero value. getLivenessScore() is null if the flow ends before passive liveness. getSimilarity() is null for standalone liveness because it does not compare identities.

  • Method Details

    • getResultEnvelope

      @Nullable public java.lang.String getResultEnvelope()
      Optional AES-256-GCM result for this flow in v2.keyId.payload format. Returns null when encryption is disabled. Your backend decrypts it using the issued session parameters.

    • getFrameJpeg

      @Nullable public byte[] getFrameJpeg()
      Terminal-frame scene JPEG, quality 95, with both dimensions at most 720 pixels. Each read returns an independent copy. The SDK also attempts to provide it for failed business outcomes. Returns null if no valid frame is available or encoding fails. Does not create files or retain previous images.

    • getFrameWidth

      public int getFrameWidth()
      JPEG width in pixels; 0 if no JPEG.

    • getFrameHeight

      public int getFrameHeight()
      JPEG height in pixels; 0 if no JPEG.

    • getOutcome

      @NonNull public FaceFlowOutcome getOutcome()
      Final business outcome; use it to decide acceptance.

    • isPassed

      public boolean isPassed()
      Whether verification passed. Equivalent to getOutcome() == FaceFlowOutcome.PASSED.

      This reads the business outcome only; it does not establish that an optional attached value exists. A passive-liveness pass includes a liveness score. Identity-only 1:1 verification can pass while getLivenessScore() remains null.

    • getAlignedFace

      @Nullable public android.graphics.Bitmap getAlignedFace()
      An independent 333 x 333 aligned face from the terminal frame, matching the frame JPEG. Returns null when no face can be cropped. A failed result may still contain an image, which is not guaranteed to show a frontal face. The image is not selected by the highest similarity across frames; scores follow the flow's aggregation rules.

    • getLivenessScore

      @Nullable public java.lang.Float getLivenessScore()
      Aggregated liveness score in [0,1]; null if not produced.

      Use getOutcome() for the final decision instead of comparing this score again in the application. Standalone liveness results PASSED and SPOOF_DETECTED include an aggregated score. It is null for identity-only 1:1 verification without passive liveness, or when the flow ends before passive liveness completes because of face acquisition, multiple faces, a lost face, an action, or final-sampling timeout. Null means no score was produced, not a score of zero.

    • getSimilarity

      @Nullable public java.lang.Float getSimilarity()
      Highest similarity in [0,1]; null if no comparison result. It is null for standalone liveness without identity comparison, or when the flow ends before comparison. The pass/fail decision is already reflected in getOutcome(); use this value for display or metrics.
